metadata.description: Cross-domain thinking, multi-model tooling, and developer productivity plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description: Iteratively decompose complex systems into their essential primitives.

plugins.name: lateral-thinking
plugins.description: Generate non-obvious hypotheses by decomposing a problem to its mechanism and raiding distant fields.

plugins.name: codex-exec
plugins.description: Run Codex headlessly for implementation, review, monitored work, and exact continuation with durable liveness artifacts.

plugins.name: codex-session
plugins.description: Inspect local Codex CLI transcripts by session UUID without launching Codex or contacting a model provider.

plugins.name: cursor
plugins.description: Run Cursor Agent headlessly with liveness artifacts, read-only review, and exact session continuation.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering-practice workflows under /engineering, including TDD, architecture, defined terms, complexity reports, CI optimization, design stress tests, and plan simplification.

plugins.name: bun-expert
plugins.description: Expert guidance for JavaScript/TypeScript development with the Bun runtime. Covers setup, servers, APIs, testing, bundling, and Node.js migration.

plugins.name: claude
plugins.description: Run Claude directly in a requested workspace with durable artifacts and exact session continuation.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Run Google Antigravity CLI headlessly with Gemini routing, durable artifacts, isolated review, and exact continuation.

plugins.name: claude-session
plugins.description: Inspect local Claude Code transcripts by session UUID without invoking Claude or contacting Anthropic.

plugins.name: cli-design-expert
plugins.description: Design or review command-line interfaces for usability and automation: help text, flags, exit codes, TTY behavior.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Five focused workflows under /code: PR readiness, behavior-preserving simplification, repository comment cleanup, runnable code understanding, and cold-start handoff.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Prepare repositories for reliable agent-driven development with behavior baselines, concise guidance, proof contracts, dependency hygiene, readiness audits, and scoped behavior capture.

plugins.name: hexagon-audit
plugins.description: Audit Ports & Adapters (Hexagonal Architecture) compliance in a packages/ + adapters/ monorepo, with a deterministic scanner for inward-dependency violations, peer-adapter imports, and vendor SDKs leaking into ports.

plugins.name: human-writer
plugins.description: Edit prose so it sounds natural, specific, and human-written. Use when a draft feels generic or model-generated.

plugins.name: improve-prompt
plugins.description: Improve vague or underspecified prompts into sharp, reusable prompts for planning, coding, review, decision, and handoff work.

plugins.name: tutorial
plugins.description: Write hands-on, self-verified tutorials where every step ends in a runnable action and the reader finishes able to do the thing.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Generate a single-file HTML visualization in an ivory/clay editorial gallery style for systems, plans, code flows, and concepts.

plugins.name: status-update
plugins.description: Turn long-running agent work into concise, evidence-backed status snapshots with clear drill-down anchors.
